All-Stars takes place every Sunday morning from 10am to 11am on the Astro. The sessions are mainly for children and teenagers with additional needs, so that the children and their families feel included in Blessington GAA.

Sessions are child-led and run like the academy, with basic football skills and fun. All volunteers have trained in autism in sport and in disability in sport through CARA. Newcomers are welcome from Blessington and the wider community.
Blessington GAA needs volunteers across all teams. No experience is necessary.
